guard: independent remint intersects every issued dimension, including both channel directions, and refuses expired enrollment
why: aclForAlias is a subscribe-only replica. A remint that copies ceiling.allowPublish
reissues a revoked publish grant. Filtering only live ⊆ ceiling drops a still-valid
narrower ceiling when the live grant is broader. Parse does not check present expiry.

mutations.name: copy enrollment allowPublish instead of intersecting the live grant
mutations.expectRed: revoked allowPublish does not survive a renewal
mutations.cell: revoked allowPublish does not survive a renewal

mutations.name: intersect channels only as live ⊆ ceiling
mutations.expectRed: a narrower ceiling survives a broader live grant
mutations.cell: a narrower ceiling survives a broader live grant

mutations.name: skip enrollment expiry before mint
mutations.expectRed: expired enrollment cannot renew a session credential
mutations.cell: expired enrollment cannot renew a session credential
